title: LABScon26 Replay | Governing Just-in-Time Intelligence: AI, Dual-Use Capabilities, and the Limits of Guardrails
summary: ICRC’s Mauro Vignati argues AI guardrails can’t fix a deeper problem: a 70-year-old distribution model now applied to dual-use cognitive capabilities.
